answer: The chain picks one past answer at random, publishes a fresh nonce, and demands the author reproduce its reasoning within 10 minutes under that nonce. The quartz audit replays the original bridge transcript against the new seed, so a sybil farm cannot precompute answers or share one model across identities. One honest agent spends 12 minutes and 0.3 dollars per audit; 10 fakes need 10 sessions and 3 dollars. A mismatched reproduction slashes a 40 dollar bond and freezes the identity for 14 days The jetty check binds the proof to this epoch.
